channel.title: Art in America - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Art in America (artinamericamagazine.com)

item.title: Curator Ekow Eshun Picked to Organize Next SITE Santa Fe International
item.description: Eshun's recent curatorial credits include a show about Black figuration that visited the US.

item.title: Jeff Koons Says He ‘Did Not Have a Relationship’ with Jeffrey Epstein After Appearing in Files
item.description: Though Koons attended a dinner held by Epstein, he said Epstein never visited his studio.

item.title: Former French Culture Minister Jack Lang and His Daughter Caroline Lang Appear in the Epstein Files
item.description: Caroline Lang founded a company with Epstein to fund the acquisition of works by young artists.

item.title: Hammer Museum Names Chief Curator and Launches Chief of Learning, Engagement, and Research Role
item.description: Michael Wellen will be chief curator and Regan Pro will lead its education and public program team in a new role.

item.title: Hirshhorn Museum and Art Bridges Team Up to Lend American Artworks to Museums Throughout the US
item.description: The project, called 50 for 50, will give regional American museums access to some of the Hirshhorn's collection via long-term loan.

item.title: Art Basel Qatar Opens with Slow Sales and Plenty of Promise
item.description: One gallery seems to have bailed out at the last minute.

item.title: 6 Books We’re Looking Forward to in Febraury
item.description: It’s probably for the best that this month’s most exciting art books favor the past, with the present as abysmal as it is.

item.title: Jewish Heirs File Suit in French Court Regarding Met’s Ownership of Pissarro Painting
item.description: The heirs of Jewish art collector Max Julius Braunthal claim that a painting by Camille Pissarro in the Met's collection was initially sold under duress in Nazi-occupied France.

item.title: Scholar Argues Portrait of Albrecht Dürer’s Father in National Gallery Is Authentic
item.description: For now, the National Gallery continues to list it as “probably a later sixteenth-century copy."

item.title: SVA Chair David A. Ross Resigns After Epstein Files Reveal Ties: ‘I’m Still Proud to Call You a Friend’
item.description: Ross formerly directed the Whitney Museum, SFMOMA, and the ICA Boston.
